domain_title: Human impact, rights, fairness, transparency, oversight and recourse
title: Transparency and communication
canonical_definition: Users and affected persons receive timely, accurate and actionable information about AI use, purpose, limitations, data use, human involvement and relevant consequences.

conditions: All systems with human users or affected persons; content and timing depend on role and legal applicability.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Are audience-specific transparency objectives, content, timing and communication responsibilities defined?
Are disclosures, labels, limitations, contact and correction routes implemented in the actual interaction and workflow?
Do comprehension, accessibility and consistency checks show that people can understand and act on the information?

capability_indicators: AI interaction is disclosed when required

conditions: Refer a material failure of transparency and communication to the accountable authority before a consequential transition.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, MEASURE 2.8 (PDF p. 35), MEASURE 2.9 (PDF p. 35), MEASURE 3.3 (PDF p. 36)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on examining transparency, contextual explanation and feedback mechanisms. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

governance_purpose: Make transparency and communication verifiable against the current AI system, decision context and accountable ownership.
distinct_claim: E3 evaluates transparency and communication using evidence from intent through operation. AP-E3 independently assesses evidence of decorative or incomplete transparency.

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: The versioned definition identifies a communication plan specifying each audience, timing, required explanations, limitations and contact or correction routes. Record the accountable owner, scope and material assumptions.
The current release demonstrates audience-specific disclosures and accessible information placed at the actual interaction or decision point. Trace the decisions and controls to attributable records.

Representative, executed evidence provides observed comprehension, accessibility and accurate use of contact or correction routes across representative interactions. Compare expected and observed outcomes and record exceptions.
For an operating system, current records cover the material paths involved in transparency and communication, including relevant exceptions and changes.

required_evidence.title: Versioned scope and control definition
required_evidence.description: Provide a communication plan specifying each audience, timing, required explanations, limitations and contact or correction routes. Include the affected workflow, current version and accountable owner.

required_evidence.title: Effective implementation records
required_evidence.description: Demonstrate audience-specific disclosures and accessible information placed at the actual interaction or decision point. Trace the scope, control and authority to the current implementation, including exceptions.

required_evidence.title: Representative verification results
required_evidence.description: Provide observed comprehension, accessibility and accurate use of contact or correction routes across representative interactions. Include current version, test scope, criteria, expected and observed outcomes, and unresolved failures.

required_evidence.title: Current operating or change evidence
required_evidence.description: Retain dated records that show how transparency and communication works for the assessed scope, including the relevant exceptions and any material change since the evidence was captured.

sufficiency: Start with a communication plan specifying each audience, timing, required explanations, limitations and contact or correction routes. Reconcile it against the effective controls and representative results for the same operating scope and version.

Use observed comprehension, accessibility and accurate use of contact or correction routes across representative interactions to support effectiveness at the relevant lifecycle stage. Record missing paths and unresolved conflicts as UNKNOWN. A verified shortfall can support a gap without resolving the other questions.
Reassess affected evidence after a material change. An accountable human validates or approves the result where required by the lifecycle target.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A specification supports DECLARED intent. Effective implementation records may support IMPLEMENTED. Representative executed tests support TESTED within their scope. Current operating evidence supports OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED for covered paths and time. Record human assurance independently.
false_positive_guards: Different notices may suit different audiences where each conveys material information at the right decision point.
Reconcile document claims with the effective release, actual operation and relevant exceptions before recording satisfaction.
prohibited_inferences: A capability gap alone cannot establish AP-E3 presence.
An approved design or evidence plan cannot establish test execution or operational effectiveness.
Satisfying this capability cannot by itself authorize progression or establish legal compliance.

finding_definitions.title: Material definition or intent gap in transparency and communication
Verified implementation or effectiveness gap in transparency and communication
Evidence remains insufficient for transparency and communication in the assessed scope
